label: local
command:
bash -lc '
set -u
status=0
for f in requirements*.txt; do
  echo === $f ===
  .venv/bin/pip-audit --progress-spinner=off -r "$f"
  code=$?
  echo EXIT $f $code
  if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then status=$code; fi
done
exit $status
'
